target.title: [AI] fix(feishu): use formatErrorMessage for sender name resolution error log
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`bot-sender-name.ts` logs `String(err)` when Feishu sender name resolution fails, which can leak API tokens and credentials into gateway logs.

- **Problem**: `String(err)` preserves raw Feishu API error text that may contain tenant access tokens, app secrets, or other credentials returned in error responses
- **Solution**: Replace with `formatErrorMessage(err)` which redacts secrets before logging. This matches the existing pattern used in `probe.ts`, `tool-result.ts`, `drive.ts`, `bitable.ts`, and `monitor.comment.ts` in the same extension.
- **What changed**: `extensions/feishu/src/bot-sender-name.ts` (+2/-1 — add import, replace 1 call site)
- **What did NOT change**: Log message structure, error handling flow, sender name resolution logic

## Change Type (select all)

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor required for the fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Chore/infra

## Scope (select all)

- [ ] Gateway / orchestration
- [ ] Skills / tool execution
- [ ] Auth / tokens
- [ ] Memory / storage
- [x] Integrations
- [ ] API / contracts
- [ ] UI / DX
- [ ] CI/CD / infra

## Linked Issue/PR

- [ ] This PR fixes a bug or regression

## Motivation

When the Feishu API returns an error during sender name resolution (e.g. invalid token, permission denied), the error response may contain sensitive credentials in its body. `String(err)` serializes the full error object including any attached API response data. `formatErrorMessage` redacts secrets while preserving actionable error text, matching the pattern already used by 5 other files in the same extension.

## Evidence

- **Behavior addressed**: Feishu sender name resolution errors are logged without leaking API secrets
- **Real environment tested**: Linux x64, Node v24.13.1, branch `fix/feishu-format-error-sender-name`
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch**:

```console
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/bot-sender-name.test.ts --run
```

- **Evidence after fix**:

```console
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
```

- **Observed result after fix**: Error log uses `formatErrorMessage(err)` which redacts secrets while preserving the error text for debugging
- **What was not tested**: Live Feishu API error with real credentials in error body

## Root Cause

`bot-sender-name.ts` was authored without `formatErrorMessage` import. Five other files in the same extension (`probe.ts`, `tool-result.ts`, `drive.ts`, `bitable.ts`, `monitor.comment.ts`) already use `formatErrorMessage` for the same purpose.

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

None. Error log output is redacted of secrets but semantically equivalent for debugging.

## Security Impact (required)

- [x] New permissions/capabilities? No
- [x] Secrets/tokens handling changed? No (improved: secrets now redacted in logs)
- [x] New/changed network calls? No
- [x] Command/tool execution surface changed? No
- [x] Data access scope changed? No

## Compatibility / Migration

- [x] Backward compatible? Yes
- [x] Config/env changes? No
- [x] Migration needed? No

## Best-fix Verdict

- **Best fix**: Yes. Uses the same `formatErrorMessage` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/error-runtime` already imported by sibling files.
- **Refactor needed**: No
- **Alternative considered**: Importing a different secret-redaction helper — rejected because `formatErrorMessage` is the standard SDK helper used throughout the extension

## AI Assistance 🤖

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **AI model**: deepseek-v4-pro
- **Human confirmed understanding of code changes**: Yes

## Risks and Mitigations

- **Highest-risk area**: None. Single call site, well-tested SDK helper, no behavioral change.
- **Mitigation**: N/A
- **Compatibility impact**: None
